name: pghh-annual-report-2024-25-transition
description: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited (stock-exchange symbol PGHH) Annual Report 2024-25, covering the nine-month financial year from 1 July 2024 to 31 March 2025 between its July-June and April-March calendars, expressed with exceptions.history (fiscalclock 0.2.0). The transition's three quarters of three months, the quarters of the other years and the week block are illustrative: the reports print no quarter or week dates. Only fields the documents state are asserted; the year before the transition is located by date, because its label 2023-24 is inferred.

source.citation: "The Board of Directors of the Company, on January 23, 2025, approved the change in the Financial Year of the Company from “July 1 – June 30” period to “April 1 – March 31” period. Consequently, the Financial Year of the Company for the period under review, viz., 2024-25, is a period of 9 months commencing on July 1, 2024, and ending on March 31, 2025. Subsequent financial years of the Company shall commence on April 1 every year and end on March 31 of the succeeding year." (Directors' Report, p. 10) "the numbers are not comparable to the previous financial year, which was a twelve months period (July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024)." (p. 10) Annual Report 2025-26: "The Financial Year of the Company for period under review, viz., 2025-26, commenced on April 1, 2025, and ended on March 31, 2026." (p. 9). Establishes the bounds and the label 2024-25 of the nine-month transition year, the twelve-month year before it, and the bounds and label of 2025-26, the year after it. The 274-day length is calendar arithmetic on the stated first and last days, not a figure the filing prints.
